title: Specs Run Metadata Schema
description: Facts about the generation run that produced a set of component specs — identical for every component in that run, and carrying no per-component data. (ADR-089)

RunMetadata.description: Facts about the generation run that produced a set of component specs.

license.description: Resolved license state at the time this component spec was generated. Absent when no license was supplied.

status.description: License validation status (e.g. VALID, EXPIRED, NONE).

level.description: Output entitlement level (e.g. FREE, PRO, EXTENDED). Plain string for extensibility.

url.description: Versioned schema URL pinned to a git tag (e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../v0.13.0/schema/component.schema.json)

latest.description: Stable URL pointing to the latest schema on the main branch for discovery

conventions.description: Conventions of the one platform that produced this spec. A missing platform did not produce it. (ADR-079)

settings.description: Choices about the run that generated this spec.
